queries_run: Capital One Financial regulatory scrutiny CFPB DOJ antitrust Discover 2026
Capital One Brex acquisition antitrust HSR clearance

findings.claim: 10-K 載明 Brex 收購的交割條件包含 Hart-Scott-Rodino 反壟斷申報許可。
findings.excerpt: The completion of the Brex Transaction is subject to the satisfaction of customary closing conditions, including clearance under the Hart-Scott-Rodino Antitrust Improvements Act of 1976, as amended.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子：監管機關可能限制公司的併購或擴張能力，且重疊調查、罰款、限制產品等可能損害業務。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: which could involve restrictions on our activities, or our ability to make acquisitions or otherwise expand our business, among other limitations that could adversely affect our business.

findings.claim: 10-K 載明商家與商家團體對發卡銀行（含公司）提起多起反壟斷訴訟，主張交換費等做法違反聯邦反壟斷法；英國、加拿大等地對交換費設有上限或自願協議。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: Merchants and their trade groups have filed numerous lawsuits against payment card networks and banks that issue cards on those networks, claiming that their practices toward merchants, including interchange fees, violate federal antitrust laws.

findings.claim: Law360 報導一群消費者請求加州聯邦法官阻止 Capital One 51.5 億美元收購 Brex，主張違反反壟斷法（付費牆，未見裁定結果）。
findings.source: Law360 'Capital One's $5B Brex Purchase Must Be Blocked, Judge Told'

findings.claim: Capital One 完成 Brex 收購，稱已取得所有必要監管核准與交割條件。
findings.source: Nasdaq 'Capital One Completes Brex Buyout, Boosts Digital Payments Strategy'

regulatory_antitrust.note: 搜尋摘要稱 Nasdaq 報導 Brex 已交割，但未取得一手文件確認 HSR 許可與消費者訴訟結果，未列為 finding。 線索 1 條，程式核實 0 條，1 條以搜尋摘要保留（未核原文）
